== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[WED-1016 'Techie' Droid (Japanese)|WED-1016 'Techie' Droid]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156433111/zcsKLN0V0EG2tkeR9zT0xw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89232349.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>32690418e5b374d1122e589594a6e00b8d3c313868d5a2fb6e199aa92ba0b31f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
